name: max_locks_per_transaction
description: Sets the maximum number of object locks allocated per transaction; total shared lock table size is derived from max_locks_per_transaction * (max_connections + max_prepared_transactions).
symptoms: failed transactions due to 'out of shared memory'
replication failure on standby if lower than master
tuning_tips: Increase this value if encountering 'out of shared memory' errors during complex DML involving many tables or partitions; monitor lock usage via pg_locks and adjust incrementally, keeping in mind its impact on shared memory footprint.
